name: Johnny Kohler
caption: A recently turned eighteen-year-old high school wrestler guilt-tripped into carrying his grandfather Jerry "Pops" Kohler to a bucket-list wrestling match as half of The Flying Kohlers, the tag team that applied to Internet Championship Wrestling in August 2012.

tenures.source: /promotions/icw-2012/archive/flying-kohlers-icw-application-2012-08-19.html (his application) and /promotions/icw-2012/rp/flying-kohler-boys-segment-2012-09-11.html (the segment before the team's match)

notes: Known from the team's application of 19 August 2012, served at /promotions/icw-2012/archive/flying-kohlers-icw-application-2012-08-19.html: 6'2" and 234 lbs, a face from Chicago, Illinois, who pushes Pops to the ring in a wheelchair and ties opponents in a knot for the Kohler Death Rattle; and from the pre-match segment of 11 September 2012, served at /promotions/icw-2012/rp/flying-kohler-boys-segment-2012-09-11.html, in which he is scared of his first crowd.

name: Archaeopteryx
caption: A masked, colourfully dressed high flyer from Pangea whose application to Internet Championship Wrestling in September 2012 announces him as the original bird and ends in a CACAW.

tenures.note: The application does not name the fed; it fills in the same form, with the same fields, as the Kohlers' ICW application of 19 August 2012, and was sent three weeks later.

notes: Known from one application, served at /promotions/icw-2012/archive/archaeopteryx-icw-application-2012-09-06.html: a neutral high flyer, 5'11" and 200 lbs, from Pangea, entering to "Spread Your Wings" by Queen; his sample roleplay has him accept a challenge bestowed by the gods to evolve into a bird.
